The prompt asks for a Modal app that calls Grok from xAI, and uses its X search tool to find the posts. It runs on a monthly schedule and backfills earlier months, so every trend line has real data points.

The prompt asks for a Modal app that calls Grok from ex A I, and uses its X search tool to find the posts. It runs on a monthly schedule and backfills earlier months, so every trend line has real data points.
0007a.png

So why Modal? A monthly job shouldn't depend on a laptop being awake, or on a server you pay for all month. On Modal, a cron schedule starts the pull and .map() runs the searches in parallel containers. A Volume keeps the results, and a web endpoint serves the page at a public URL. The xAI key sits in a Modal Secret, and the app scales to zero between runs, so you only pay for the seconds it works.
